# SBD Python Bindings — CoreWeave GB200 Setup
# =============================================
# Updated: 2026-05-12
#
# Slurm cluster, ARM64 (aarch64) GB200 compute nodes with 4 GPUs each.
# Login node is x86_64 — every build and run has to happen on a compute
# node via `srun` or `sbatch`.

# 1. aarch64 miniforge (the login node's x86_64 one will not run on compute)
cd ~
curl -sL -o miniforge-arm.sh https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Miniforge3-Linux-aarch64.sh
srun -p hpc-mid -N 1 -n 1 -t 15 bash ~/miniforge-arm.sh -b -p ~/miniforge3

# 2. Python 3.12 conda env (system python3 is 3.10, no ensurepip, no sudo)
srun -p hpc-mid -N 1 -n 1 -t 10 \
    ~/miniforge3/bin/mamba create -n py312 -y python=3.12 lld -c conda-forge

# 3. venv from the aarch64 conda Python (don't run this on login — the
#    Python binary is aarch64 and will die with `Exec format error`)
srun -p hpc-mid -N 1 -n 1 -t 10 bash -c '
  ~/miniforge3/envs/py312/bin/python -m venv ~/venv-sbd &&
  source ~/venv-sbd/bin/activate &&
  pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
'

# 4. Environment variables — drop this into ~/sbd-env.sh and `source` it
cat > ~/sbd-env.sh << 'EOF'
# Login node is x86_64; compute nodes are aarch64 (GB200).
# NVHPC / HPC-X / miniforge are all aarch64-only — all builds and runs
# must happen on a compute node (srun / sbatch).

export NVHPC=/mnt/home/walkup/hpc_sdk
export NVHPC_VER=26.1
export NVHPC_ROOT=$NVHPC/Linux_aarch64/$NVHPC_VER

export HPCX_ROOT=$NVHPC_ROOT/comm_libs/12.9/hpcx/hpcx-2.25.1
export MPI_HOME=$HPCX_ROOT/ompi
export HPCX_UCX_DIR=$HPCX_ROOT/ucx
export NVHPC_HOME=$NVHPC_ROOT/compilers

# Pin CUDA to 12.9 to match HPC-X 12.9 and the system's ld.so cache.
# (NVHPC's /cuda symlink otherwise points at 13.1, which causes a
# libcudart.so.12 vs libcudart.so.13 collision as soon as SBD + MPI
# coexist in the same process — presents as Energy=0 + segfault on
# multi-rank runs, works fine single-rank.)
export CUDA_HOME=$NVHPC_ROOT/cuda/12.9
export MATH_LIBS_PATH=$NVHPC_ROOT/math_libs/12.9/targets/sbsa-linux/lib

# HPC-X was built with a different install prefix; tell OpenMPI where
# its data files actually live at runtime.
export OPAL_PREFIX=$MPI_HOME

# sbd_solver writes an FCIDUMP into TMPDIR on rank 0 and broadcasts the
# path. /tmp is node-local, so multi-node runs need a shared filesystem.
# (You can also pass --temp_dir on the run_sqd_sbd.py CLI directly.)
export TMPDIR=$HOME/sbd-tmp
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"

export BLAS_LIB_PATH=/mnt/home/walkup/OpenBLAS-0.3.31/lib
export BLAS_INCLUDE_PATH=/mnt/home/walkup/OpenBLAS-0.3.31/include
export BLAS_LIBS=openblas

# C++ compiler used by mpicxx. nvc++ is required for SBD's GPU/CUDA paths.
export OMPI_CXX=nvc++
# Intentionally NOT exporting OMPI_CC=nvc: mpi4py / other Python ext
# builds inject gcc-only flags (-fno-strict-overflow) that nvc rejects.

export PATH=$NVHPC_HOME/bin:$CUDA_HOME/bin:$MPI_HOME/bin:$PATH
# Prefix HPC-X's bundled UCX 1.20 before the system /opt/hpcx/ucx 1.19.
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$HPCX_UCX_DIR/lib:$MPI_HOME/lib:$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$MATH_LIBS_PATH:$NVHPC_HOME/lib:$BLAS_LIB_PATH:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

source ~/venv-sbd/bin/activate
EOF

# 5. Python deps (on a compute node — aarch64 wheels)
srun -p hpc-mid -N 1 -n 1 -t 15 bash -c '
  source ~/sbd-env.sh &&
  pip install numpy pybind11 pyscf cython &&
  OMPI_CC=gcc MPICC=$(which mpicc) pip install --no-binary mpi4py --no-build-isolation mpi4py &&
  pip install git+https://github.com/hfwen0502/qiskit-addon-sqd@patch-ferminon-sbd
'
# Note on mpi4py: force OMPI_CC=gcc for its build only. nvc rejects some
# gcc-only flags Python ext builds pass through (e.g. -fno-strict-overflow).

# 6. Clone the repo
cd ~
git clone https://github.com/hfwen0502/sbd.git
cd sbd
# git checkout singles-doubles-extend    # if you want the branch features

# 7. setup.py needs a local tweak to pin the CUDA toolkit nvc++ targets.
#    Without this, nvc++ links GPU libs from the 13.1 tree (its default),
#    which mismatches HPC-X 12.9 and causes the multi-rank zero-energy +
#    segfault described in section 4. Change in setup.py, both compile
#    and link extra_args for the GPU extension:
#
#      '-gpu=sm_90'                                    →
#      '-gpu=sm_90,cuda12.9'
#
#      extra_link_args=... + ['-mp', '-cuda', '-cudalib']                  →
#      extra_link_args=... + ['-mp', '-cuda', '-cudalib', '-gpu=sm_90,cuda12.9']
#
#    This edit is NOT upstreamed — `cuda12.9` would break users on
#    clusters with CUDA 13 toolchains (e.g. bluevela). Re-apply after
#    `git pull`.

# 8. Build (both CPU + GPU backends, on a compute node)
srun -p hpc-mid -N 1 -n 1 -c 16 -t 30 --gres=gpu:1 bash -c '
  source ~/sbd-env.sh &&
  cd ~/sbd &&
  SBD_BUILD_BACKEND=both CC=nvc CXX=nvc++ CFLAGS= CXXFLAGS= \
      pip install -e . --no-build-isolation --force-reinstall --no-deps
'

# 9. Verify (compute node required — sbd imports need CUDA + MPI runtime).
#    Don't run from ~ because ./sbd/ shadows the editable install as a
#    namespace package and you get an empty module. cd elsewhere first.
srun -p hpc-mid -N 1 -n 1 -t 5 --gres=gpu:1 bash -c '
  source ~/sbd-env.sh &&
  cd /tmp &&
  python -c "import sbd; print(sbd.available_backends())"
'
# Expected: ['cpu', 'gpu']

# 10. Run tests (sbatch — 2 nodes × 4 GPUs = 8 GPUs)
cat > ~/sbd-test.sh << 'JOBEOF'
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=sbd-test
#SBATCH --partition=hpc-mid
#SBATCH --account=cw-sup
#SBATCH --output=sbd-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=sbd-%j.err
#SBATCH --nodes=2
#SBATCH --ntasks=8
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=12
#SBATCH --time=03:00:00

source ~/sbd-env.sh
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-12}

cd ~/sbd/python/examples

echo "=== GPU diag test ==="
mpirun -np ${SLURM_NTASKS} \
    -x OMP_NUM_THREADS -x OPAL_PREFIX -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x PATH \
    python run_sbd_diag.py \
        --device gpu \
        --fcidump ../../data/h2o/fcidump.txt \
        --adetfile ../../data/h2o/h2o-1em5-alpha.txt \
        --adet_comm_size 4 --bdet_comm_size 2 \
        --tolerance 1e-5

echo "=== SQD + SBD test ==="
mpirun -np ${SLURM_NTASKS} \
    -x OMP_NUM_THREADS -x OPAL_PREFIX -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x PATH \
    python run_sqd_sbd.py \
        --fcidump ../../data/h2o/fcidump.txt \
        --counts count_dict_h2o.json \
        --device gpu \
        --samples_per_batch 300 --num_batches 3 --max_iterations 3 \
        --adet_comm_size 4 --bdet_comm_size 2 \
        --tolerance 1e-5 \
        --temp_dir $HOME/sbd-tmp

echo "=== DONE ==="
JOBEOF

sbatch ~/sbd-test.sh

# Expected results (validated job 4415):
# - GPU diag H2O 1em5 energy: -76.2437350420 Hartree
# - SQD+SBD total energy:      -18.9902836024 Hartree (2 iterations, 7.1s wall)
#
# Key paths:
#   env:         ~/sbd-env.sh
#   venv:        ~/venv-sbd
#   miniforge:   ~/miniforge3   (aarch64)
#   SBD repo:    ~/sbd
#   scratch:     ~/sbd-tmp      (shared TMPDIR for multi-node FCIDUMP broadcast)
#   NVHPC SDK:   /mnt/home/walkup/hpc_sdk/Linux_aarch64/26.1
#   OpenBLAS:    /mnt/home/walkup/OpenBLAS-0.3.31
#
# Gotchas specific to this cluster:
# - aarch64 compute nodes, x86_64 login. All `pip install` + builds via
#   srun/sbatch, not on the login node.
# - /tmp is node-local — for multi-node SQD runs, either set TMPDIR to a
#   shared path (done in sbd-env.sh) or pass --temp_dir on the CLI.
# - NVHPC /cuda symlink points at 13.1; HPC-X is 12.9. Force nvc++ to
#   target CUDA 12.9 with -gpu=sm_90,cuda12.9 (setup.py edit above) and
#   pin CUDA_HOME + MATH_LIBS_PATH at the 12.9 trees.
# - mpi4py build needs OMPI_CC=gcc (nvc rejects gcc-only flags that
#   Python's distutils injects). Set it only during the mpi4py install.
# - HPC-X was built with a different install prefix: set OPAL_PREFIX,
#   or MPI_Init fails looking for help-mpi-runtime.txt.
# - HPC-X's bundled UCX is 1.20, system's /opt/hpcx/ucx is 1.19. Prefix
#   the bundled one in LD_LIBRARY_PATH to avoid the runtime warning.
